name: @sorenllm/opencode-forge
description: General-purpose Forge agent for OpenCode with file-backed Plan and Goal harnesses, a Crew workflow with evidence-checked reports, and configurable native worker agents with model and reasoning-depth pins or inherited models.

scripts.bundle: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && bun build ./plugin.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node --format esm && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('schema/forge.schema.json','dist/forge.schema.json')"

author: chengsongren
